# Section 050 Knowledge Check: Multi-Tenancy Resources

<!-- TODO(build): generated by /astrona-course-generate-assessment against the objectives below. Scenario questions, no recall trivia. -->

## Coverage

- Cap a namespace's total CPU and memory requests and limits and object counts with a ResourceQuota
- Read used against hard in kubectl describe resourcequota
- Diagnose a pod or ReplicaSet rejected by a quota from the Forbidden message and the ReplicaSet events
- Set default requests and limits and per-container minimum and maximum with a LimitRange
- Explain why a compute quota requires every new pod to declare requests, and how a LimitRange default solves that
- Create PriorityClasses and assign them to pods with priorityClassName
- Observe a higher-priority pod preempt lower-priority pods on a full node and read the Preempted events
- Prevent preemption by a class with preemptionPolicy Never
- Limit how much of a namespace's quota high-priority pods may use with a PriorityClass scopeSelector
- Count only BestEffort or Terminating pods with quota scopes
